description_en: Queries the details of a specified event-triggered alert rule by calling the DescribeEventRuleAttribute operation
description_zh: 调用DescribeEventRuleAttribute接口查询指定事件报警规则的详情
name: DescribeEventRuleAttribute

parameters.help_en:
The name of the event-triggered alert rule.

For information about how to obtain the name of an event-triggered alert rule, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/114996.html
parameters.help_zh:
事件报警规则名称。

关于如何获取事件报警规则名称，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/114996.html
parameters.name: rule_name

parameters.help_en:
The mute period.

Unit: seconds. Default value: 86400 (1 day).

When monitoring data continuously exceeds the alert rule threshold, only one alert notification is sent within each mute period
parameters.help_zh:
通道沉默周期。

单位：秒，默认值：86400（1天）。

当监控数据持续超过报警规则阈值时，每个沉默周期内只发送一次报警通知
parameters.name: silence_time

Result.description_en: The details of the event-triggered alert rule

Description.description_en: The description of the event-triggered alert rule
Description.description_zh: 事件报警规则的描述信息

EventPattern.description_en: The event pattern. Describes the trigger conditions of the event
EventPattern.description_zh: 事件模式。用于描述事件的触发条件

EventTypeList.description_en: The list of types for the event-triggered alert rule
EventTypeList.description_zh: 事件报警规则的类型列表

items.description_en:
The type of the event-triggered alert rule.

`*` indicates that the alert rule type is not restricted
items.description_zh:
事件报警规则的类型。

`*`表示不限制报警规则类型

keyword.description_en: The list of keywords that match the event
keyword.description_zh: 事件匹配的关键字列表

Relation.description_en:
The condition for multiple keywords. Valid values:

OR: The relationship between multiple keywords is OR.
NOT: Does not contain the keyword. Matches all events that are not in the keyword list
Relation.description_zh:
多个关键字的条件。取值：

OR： 多个关键字之间或的关系。
NOT：不包含关键字。表示匹配非关键字列表中的所有事件

LevelList.description_en: The list of levels for the event-triggered alert rule
LevelList.description_zh: 事件报警规则的级别的列表

items.description_en:
The level of the event-triggered alert rule. Valid values:

CRITICAL: critical.

WARN: warning.

INFO: information
items.description_zh:
事件报警规则的级别。取值：

CRITICAL：严重。

WARN：警告。

INFO：信息

NameList.description_en: The list of names for the event-triggered alert rule
NameList.description_zh: 事件报警规则的名称的列表

Product.description_en: The name of the cloud service

SQLFilter.description_en: Filters logs by using SQL statements. An alert is triggered if the filter conditions are met
SQLFilter.description_zh: 按照SQL过滤日志。如果符合条件，则触发报警
SQLFilter.example: ycccluster1 and (i-23ij0o82612 or Executed1) or Asimulated not 222

StatusList.description_en: The list of statuses for the event-triggered alert rule
StatusList.description_zh: 事件报警规则的状态的列表

EventType.description_en:
The event type. Valid values:

SYSTEM: system event.

CUSTOM: custom event
EventType.description_zh:
事件类型。取值：

SYSTEM：系统事件。

CUSTOM：自定义事件

Name.description_en: The name of the event-triggered alert rule

State.description_en:
The status of the event-triggered alert rule. Valid values:

ENABLED: enabled.

DISABLED: disabled
State.description_zh:
事件报警规则的状态。取值：

ENABLED：启用。

DISABLED：禁用

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the operation was successful. Valid values:

true: The operation was successful.

false: The operation failed
Success.description_zh:
操作是否成功。取值：

true：成功。

false：失败
